{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-la-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"333d2b5e7f3b186fea6802cff3f96a9edcac1abd2f4fc39b7fa2a63748399edc","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-la-class-std:lineage:1","source_registry_sha256":"8fb2294cb50570a3a0fabb25acba3418dba999eb7dd305cc58b73fdf38975613","source_liveness_sha256":"1105a92b5841d065519de4b7fbea05111880de6d2bb8804066a972d19c63b5a0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Class E licensing and identity documents","heading":"Class E licensing and identity documents","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"# Class E licensing and identity documents

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
The guide treats a permanent resident card issued after July 1997 as primary identification, together with Social Security verification and a secondary document. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
The guide treats a permanent resident card issued before July 1997 as secondary identification, so it also calls for a primary document and Social Security verification. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
For the listed foreign-passport substitution, the guide requires a stamp showing that the arrival record was surrendered for permanent-resident processing, an employment-authorization card, Social Security verification and a secondary document. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A01
In that foreign-passport substitution, a stamp less than nine months old permits issuance according to the guide, while a stamp more than nine months old does not. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A01
The guide lists an application to adjust to lawful permanent residence, Social Security verification and a secondary document as another identification combination. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A01
The older resident-alien card designated I-151 is no longer accepted as proof of identity or status in the guide. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A01
A refugee must present an arrival record establishing refugee status and two secondary documents, and should also present an available passport with the employment-authorization card. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A01
The guide accepts an original Refugee Resettlement Program letter with a color photograph for fifteen days after issuance. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A01
A nonimmigrant applicant’s listed documents are a foreign passport with an arrival record showing immigration status, Social Security verification and a secondary document. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A01
A student holding an F-1, J-1 or M-1 status must present the student document that identifies the school, program duration and school representative contact details. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A01
The guide requires at least thirty days of remaining visa or arrival-record validity before issuing a license or identification card, and denies issuance when less time remains. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A01
A person who is not a Louisiana resident is not eligible for a Louisiana driver license or identification card. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A01
The primary-document birth-record list includes an original birth certificate or a certified birth-certificate copy, and says a short-form birth card does not need a seal. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A02
A birth-registration record from a state or county vital-statistics bureau is included among primary identity documents. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R15 | anchor: A02
The primary identity list includes a State Department certificate documenting a birth abroad. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R16 | anchor: A02
A naturalization certificate is included in the primary identity list. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R17 | anchor: A02
A Native American tribal document is included in the primary identity list. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R18 | anchor: A02
A United States passport book or passport card may serve as a primary document. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R19 | anchor: A02
An applicant seventeen or younger using a passport must also present a certified birth certificate or papers establishing custody or legal guardianship. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R20 | anchor: A02
A foreign passport used as a primary document needs the appropriate stamp and accompanying immigration papers. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R21 | anchor: A02
The primary immigration-document list includes a permanent resident card, a Homeland Security refugee travel document or a Homeland Security permit to reenter the United States. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R22 | anchor: A02
The guide’s primary military-document list includes a current United States military identification card, dependent identification, a draft record, separation record, Selective Service notification or Coast Guard Merchant Mariner card. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R23 | anchor: A02
The name on a secondary identification document should match the name on the primary document. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R24 | anchor: A02
An out-of-state motor-vehicle agency’s license or identification card may be secondary identification when its photograph clearly identifies the person. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R25 | anchor: A02
If an applicant has lost an out-of-state license, the guide requires an official driving record from the last state that issued it. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R26 | anchor: A02
A foreign driver license must be accompanied by the appropriate immigration documents. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R27 | anchor: A02
Social Security verification may use the Social Security card, official verification from the Social Security Administration or verbal verification. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R28 | anchor: A02
The secondary photo-identification list includes Louisiana school identification, law-enforcement identification, qualifying employer identification and identification from government agencies or Louisiana correctional authorities. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R29 | anchor: A02
The secondary identification list also includes a Transportation Worker Identification Credential or a Homeland Security employment-authorization document. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R30 | anchor: A02
For secondary identification, an original Refugee Resettlement Program letter needs the agency director’s signature and a raised seal, and lasts fifteen days from issuance. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R31 | anchor: A02
High-school, college or university educational diplomas, certificates or licenses appear in the secondary-document list. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]
